sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Disease History is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good afternoon, young man. I have been looking for someone like you just now. I have received information about a new vaccine against a rare strain of flu virus that was being tested at the Reserve base, officially... I cannot tell you what was actually tested there, but TerraGroup is somehow involved in this. The results of these tests could prove extremely valuable for humanity... and the group of my western clients. I need to find those tests, so you have to travel to the Reserve base and find the medical observation journals for patients. This documentation should be somewhere in the locked rooms of the medical unit. Will you take on this task? Of course, you will be rewarded for your work."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain Medical record #1 on Reserve
- Obtain Medical record #2 on Reserve
- Hand over the first journal to Therapist
- Hand over the second journal to Therapist

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,00 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Ophthalmoscope
"Did you manage to find them? Thank you very much. Of course, these documents will be used only for the good of humanity, you can trust me."

| RB-KSM key | RB-KSM key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks room RB-KSM on the second floor of the hospital building (White Bishop) on Reserve where the Medical Journal #1 is located. |
| RB-SMP key | RB-SMP key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks room RB-SMP on the second floor of the hospital building (White Bishop) on Reserve where the Medical Journal #2 is located. |
| Medical record 1 | Medical record #1 | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| Medical record 2 | Medical record #2 | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
The medical record journals are located in two locked rooms on the second floor of the hospital building (White Bishop) on Reserve.

The first one is located in the RB-KSM room in the bottom right compartment of the left hand cabinet after entering.

The second one is located in the RB-SMP room on the floor between the right hand shelves after entering.
